skills.title: Modeling
skills.scope: whole UJG document modeling across Core, Graph, Surface and Experience, Runtime, Mapping, Metrics, Localization, Observability, Experience Annotation, and optional modules

skills.title: Core Modeling
skills.scope: Core module document containers, imports, top-level nodes, and extensions

skills.title: Graph Modeling
skills.scope: Graph module topology, journeys, states, transitions, exits, outgoing navigation, and indexes

skills.title: Design System Modeling
skills.scope: Design System module semantics and its relationship to Graph and Surface

skills.title: Localization Modeling
skills.scope: Localization module semantics for MessageMeta copy metadata, addressable Message values, Locale resources, and locale-switch metadata

skills.title: Observability Modeling
skills.scope: Observability module semantics for ObservationBinding, ObservationEvent input modality requirements, accessible-object locators, surface recognition contracts, and SurfaceInstanceResolver
